cause: The continuity gate inferred source and consumer documentation from file location alone and imposed one source-repository contract everywhere; it did not consume the v2 config and lock ownership evidence already produced by adoption.
prevention: Keep source-repository documentation strict, but activate generated-consumer behavior only when v2 config and v2 lock agree on project, upstream, and ownership; validate common rules from digest-matched managed AGENT_RUNTIME.md, keep seed-once documents strict, and enforce the pointer in every mode.
summary: A Bean Wiki installation passed portable pointer continuity but Owner governance then required Agent Runtime source-repository wording in an unmanaged README and explicitly host-owned AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
title: Portable governance must respect consumer document ownership
